gloss: in order to; so as to; with the aim of

definitions.gloss: in order to; so as to; with the aim of
definitions.explanation: Formal expression attached to the dictionary form of a verb to indicate purpose or intent. The conjunctive form of べし. Common in formal written Japanese including news, business, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}すべく、{専門家|せんもんか}を{招|まね}いた。
examples.english: They invited an expert in order to resolve the problem.

examples.japanese: {目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}すべく、{毎日|まいにち}{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: He continued making efforts every day so as to achieve his goal.

examples.japanese: より{良|よ}いサービスを{提供|ていきょう}すべく、{全社|ぜんしゃ}{一丸|いちがん}となって{取|と}り{組|く}んでいます。
examples.english: We are working as a whole company in order to provide better service.

notes:
Conjunctive form of べし. Attaches to the dictionary form of verbs.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Verb (dict form) + べく: 行くべく、{来|く}るべく
- する → すべく (contraction): {解決|かいけつ}すべく (= {解決|かいけつ}するべく)

Register: formal/written only. Not used in casual conversation — use ために or ように in everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ために: in order to — the everyday alternative
- ように: so that; in order to — used with non-volitional verbs
- べき: should; ought to (attributive form of べし)
- べし: should; must (archaic/formal predicative form)
